description: List Zypper repositories on SUSE and openSUSE.

return_values.name: repodatalist
return_values.description: A list of repository descriptions like it is returned by the command zypper repos. Returned: always

return_values.name: alias
return_values.description: The alias of the repository. Returned: success Sample: "SLE-Product-SLES"

return_values.name: autorefresh
return_values.description: Indicates, if autorefresh is enabled on the repository. Returned: success Sample: 1

return_values.name: enabled
return_values.description: Indicates, if the repository is enabled. Returned: success Sample: 1

return_values.name: gpgcheck
return_values.description: Indicates, if the GPG signature of the repository meta data is checked. Returned: success Sample: 1

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the repository. Returned: success Sample: "SLE-Product-SLES"

return_values.name: priority
return_values.description: The priority of the repository. Returned: success Sample: 99

return_values.name: url
return_values.description: The URL of the repository on the internet. Returned: success Sample: "http://repo:50000/repo/SUSE/Products/SLE-Product-SLES/15-SP2/x86_64/product"
